sections.description: The plugin enables the synchronization of Rentopian system data with your company's storefront (website).
sections.installation:
**Important!** The plugin requires the latest version of [WooCommerce](https://wordpress.org/plugins/woocommerce/ "WooCommerce") to be installed and activated.

Install and Activate the plugin through the 'Plugins' menu in WordPress

  • All existing plugin-side delivery settings are now managed through the Rentopian core system’s delivery settings section.
